section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study (Study 1) examining the psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Iran among university students. The study found a one-factor structure for the BAS-2 in both men and women, with the Persian BAS-2 showing convergent validity with self-esteem and life satisfaction, though with small effect sizes. Notably, the BAS-2 was negatively associated with BMI in women but positively associated with BMI in men, contradicting previous research findings.

section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the psychometric properties of the Persian BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) in an Iranian university population. The study found a one-factor structure for the BAS-2 in both men and women, with evidence for convergent validity. Notably, BAS-2 was negatively correlated with BMI in women (r = -.24) but positively associated with BMI in men (r = .12), contradicting previous research. The study used self-reported BMI as a limitation and did not collect ethnicity data.
